races.name: Human

attributes.application: Flat +2 percentage points added to each selected attribute score (e.g. 35% becomes 37%), not 2% of current score.

traits.name: Adaptable
traits.effect: Choose three distinct attributes; each increases by 2 percentage points (e.g. 35% to 37%).

traits.name: Versatile
traits.effect: Gain one additional Skill Talent of choice at character creation.

traits.name: Essence Affinity
traits.effect: Gain 5% additional Essence from all sources.

races.notes: Approved racial mechanics. Attributes themselves are percentages; +2% means +2 percentage points, not multiplicative scaling. Essence bonus remains multiplicative +5%.

lore.habitats: Found in almost any environment across the realms of Mezoria
lore.cultures: Many distinct cultures distributed across the realms; no single universal human culture

races.name: Sylvan

abilities.name: Forest Stride
abilities.description: Ordinary natural forest undergrowth, roots, fallen branches, and vegetation do not impose movement penalties on the Sylvan.
abilities.limitations: Does not bypass magical obstacles, impassable terrain, or physical hazards that genuinely prevent movement.

races.notes: Approved: tall graceful mystical forest race, +3 percentage points Prowess and Presence, 5% Nature Resistance, base movement 6, Forest Stride. Resistance math pending.
